analysis.reason: 직전 3영업일 연속 하락 마감 후 오늘 소폭 반등 시도했으나, RSI는 여전히 과매도 구간에 머물러 있고 ADX는 21.8로 추세가 형성되지 않아 방향성 부재. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 1.66으로 움직임에 힘이 실리나, 추세 전환 신호는 불확실하여 관망.
analysis.reasonEn: After three consecutive days of decline, a slight rebound attempt was made today. However, RSI remains in oversold territory, and ADX at 21.8 indicates no established trend, suggesting a lack of direction. The volume ratio of 1.66 suggests momentum, but the signals for a trend reversal are uncertain, warranting a wait-and-see approach.

· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (하단 $499.50) — 하단 접근 구간, 밴드폭 22.17%로 변동성 확대 가능성

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($491.46) vs SMA5/20/50 ($540.54/$561.77/$568.86) — Below short-to-mid-term moving averages, indicating a weak trend position.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($481.25)/SMA200 ($398.36) — Above mid-to-long-term moving averages, maintaining mid-to-long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (61.2%) + Current price level is historically high relative to the low.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (36.7→40.9) — Attempting to exit oversold territory, confirming weak rebound momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-5.0449→-5.0449) — Maintaining bearish convergence, indicating no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band $499.50) — Approaching the lower band, with a band width of 22.17% suggesting potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($498.54) — Support level based on 20-day low and Bollinger Band lower band.
· Swing Resistance ($533.74) — First resistance zone for short-term rebounds.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low / Higher Low) — Confirmation of support at lows, potential for recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.66x) — Momentum is present in recent movements, increasing reliability.
· Current Stage Diagnosis (Distribution Phase) — Despite short-term oversold exit attempts, trend reversal is uncertain, confirming conditions for observation.
analysis.patternNote: 5일 저가와 20일 저가가 유사한 수준으로, 현재 가격대는 주요 지지선 근처에서 횡보하며 방향성을 탐색하는 구간으로 판단됨.
analysis.patternNoteEn: The 5-day and 20-day lows are at similar levels, indicating the current price range is consolidating near key support, searching for direction.
keyPoints: RSI가 과매도 구간에서 벗어나려는 움직임을 보이나, 아직 중립 구간으로 진입하지 못함.
ADX가 21.8로 추세가 형성되지 않아 단기 변동성에 대한 주의 필요.
거래량 비율이 1.66으로 증가하며 움직임에 힘이 실리나, 추세 전환을 확신하기에는 근거 부족.
keyPointsEn: RSI shows signs of exiting oversold but has not yet entered neutral territory.
ADX at 21.8 indicates no established trend, requiring caution against short-term volatility.
Volume ratio increased to 1.66, adding momentum to price action, but evidence for a trend reversal remains insufficient.
analysis.riskNote: ADX가 20 미만으로 추세가 미형성된 상태에서 거래량 증가와 함께 반등 시도가 나타나, 위장 반등 가능성을 염두에 두어야 함.
analysis.riskNoteEn: With ADX below 20 and no established trend, the rebound attempt accompanied by increased volume suggests a potential for a false rally.
analysis.continuity: 직전 3영업일 연속 하락 마감 후, 오늘 RSI 과매도 탈출 시도하며 4일 연속 관망세를 이어감. RSI 궤적이 36.7에서 40.9로 소폭 상승했으나, 여전히 과매도 구간에 머물러 있어 매수 전환은 보류.
analysis.continuityEn: Following three consecutive days of decline, the trend of observing the market continues for the fourth day as RSI attempts to exit oversold territory. The RSI trajectory rose slightly from 36.7 to 40.9 but remains in oversold territory, deferring a buy signal.
